verification.notes: IRIS granola-intake pulse liveness -- the consumer is an LLM automation (Codex thread 019fd4e5); if the thread dies, intake halts silently. Exit-code only, content-free. Stale = committed_at older than 24h.

pitfalls.entry: Vault holds handoffs + cross-product knowledge ONLY -- never marketing outputs (those live in the product/workspace repos).
Local HEAD sits on a long-lived chore/triage branch that diverges materially from origin/main (origin/main lacks the adjudication system); do not treat HEAD as main.
Repo carries git submodules (.gitmodules) -- nested repos exist; scope operations to the correct tree.
Never merge or direct-push to a default branch -- merge is Anthony's.
